units.source_text: 然而，那份微笑里，没有我必须承担责任和义务的规则。

en.t: However, in that smile, there was no rule saying I had to bear responsibility and obligation.

units.source_text: 我的脱逃，如果使女人有所失去的话，那最多不过是些可以换来收音机和镜子的生活残片。

en.t: If my escape caused the woman to lose anything, at most it was only fragments of life that could be exchanged for a radio and a mirror.
